assessments.reasoning: The labeled Xerox cover and introductory text identify the July 1981 revision and describe Interlisp-D as a revision and implementation of the Interlisp VM for the Dolphin and Dorado. The overview separates the underlying Interlisp dialect and the AltoLisp predecessor.

challenge.method: Check the archive’s initial date against the source cover and compare the subject with the Moore VM specification, Interlisp-VAX and later Medley material.
challenge.results: The cover has both the September 1980 date and the July 1981 revision. The VM publication is a separate implementor-facing specification. The VAX report covers the ISI implementation on DEC VAX, and the Venue manual is separately identified as April 1993 Medley. Neither controls the proposition.

limitations: The reviewed implementation identity is the historically documented Dolphin/Dorado scope. No exclusivity for those machines across all later uses of the name is inferred.
